logger.doc:name: Start Log
logger.message: transactionID: #[vars.transactionId], correlationID: #[vars.correlationId], message: "Started update covid case flow", payload: #[payload]

db:select.doc:name: Select Case by NationalID
db:select.db:sql: SELECT case_id, source, case_type, first_name, last_name, phone, email, date_of_birth, national_id, national_id_type, street_address, city, state, postal, country, create_date, update_date FROM cvd_case_master WHERE national_id = :national_id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: output application/json var actionDate = now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} var owner = "UHIS" --- payload map (covidCase, indexOfCovidCase) -> { caseId: payload.covidCase.case_iD, source: payload.covidCase.source, caseType: payload.covidCase.case_type, firstName: payload.covidCase.firs_name, lastName: payload.covidCase.last_name, phone: payload.covidCase.phone, email: payload.covidCase.email, dateOfBirth: payload.covidCase.date_of_birth as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd" }, nationalId: payload.covidCase.national_id, nationalIdType: payload.covidCase.national_id_type, address:{ streetAddress: payload.covidCase.address.street_address, city: payload.covidCase.address.city, state: upper(payload.covidCase.address.state), postal: payload.covidCase.address.postal, country: payload.covidCase.address.country }, createDate: owner, updateDate: owner }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "code": 404, "message": "Resource not found", "description": "The server has not found anything matching the Request", "dateTime": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, "transactionId": vars.transactionId }
